import ctypes
import os

# Load the libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the function prototypes
# double gsl_cdf_chisq_P(const double x, const double nu);
gsl.gsl_cdf_chisq_P.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double]
gsl.gsl_cdf_chisq_P.restype = ctypes.c_double

# double gsl_cdf_chisq_Q(const double x, const double nu);
gsl.gsl_cdf_chisq_Q.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double]
gsl.gsl_cdf_chisq_Q.restype = ctypes.c_double


def chi_squared_cdf(x, nu):
    """
    Compute the CDF and complementary CDF for a chi-squared distribution.

    Parameters:
    x (float): The value at which to evaluate the CDF.
    nu (float): The degrees of freedom.

    Returns:
    tuple: A tuple containing the CDF and complementary CDF values.
    """
    cdf = gsl.gsl_cdf_chisq_P(x, nu)
    ccdf = gsl.gsl_cdf_chisq_Q(x, nu)
    return cdf, ccdf
